in_arabic.name: Elika
in_arabic.long_meaning: Elika هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. From the Arabic word 'al-nur' meaning 'the light'. This name is often given to babies born in the springtime or during the day.

in_urdu.name: Elika
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Light
in_urdu.long_meaning: Elika ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ From the Arabic word 'al-nur' meaning 'the light'. This name is often given to babies born in the springtime or during the day.

in_hindi.name: Elika
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है Light
in_hindi.long_meaning: Elika एक इस्लामी नाम है जो मुस्लिम संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। From the Arabic word 'al-nur' meaning 'the light'. This name is often given to babies born in the springtime or during the day.

in_pashto.name: Elika
in_pashto.meaning: اسلامي نوم چې معنی یې ده Light
in_pashto.long_meaning: Elika یو اسلامي نوم دی چې په مسلم کلتور کې ژوره روحاني اهميت لري. From the Arabic word 'al-nur' meaning 'the light'. This name is often given to babies born in the springtime or during the day.
